comparisons.topology: both surface meshes are watertight with edge incidence two and bounds [0,0,0]..[1,2,3] meters
comparisons.recovered_constraints: all 12 exact edges and all 6 exact faces occur in canonical solver-boundary provenance
comparisons.geometry_deviation: both boundary vertex sets lie on an exact box plane within 1e-10 meters and integrate to area 22
comparisons.element_distributions: OCCT has 12 surface triangles, RunMat has 16, and their median triangle-area ratio remains in [0.25,4]
comparisons.solver_outputs: RunMat and the independent six-tetrahedron mesh both produce volume 6 and linear-gradient energy 84

mismatches.explanation: RunMat constructively preserves the constrained surface/volume interface and introduces four additional boundary triangles. The meshes still agree on watertight topology, exact bounds, area, volume, deviation, and the governed element-area distribution. Equality of triangulation count is not a geometric invariant.
